誰說認識新朋友一定要正式？來吧，放鬆心情，隨便聊聊！在這裡，我們打破語言的界限，透過輕鬆的對話，認識來自世界各國的朋友！💖

你準備好從別的國度偷學一些新笑話嗎？還是想了解哪個國家的文化最迷人？

在餐聚中，我們會有文化交流與美味餐食的提供，歡迎有興趣的在校生與外籍同學一同共襄盛舉！

👉一起去 Chill & Chat 吧！👈

📍時間：3/25 （二）12:00-13:30

📍活動地點: 集賢館2樓 無邊境員生消費合作社

📍主辦單位: 洄瀾共好大學社會責任中心

📍中心信箱: techusr@gms.ndhu.edu.tw

(本次活動以「國際生」為主)

報名連結:  https://forms.gle/N84Vei9o14j34bS56
(表單填寫期限為 3/21 24:00)

Who says meeting new people has to be formal? Come on, relax and chat! Here, we break the language barrier and make friends from all over the world through relaxed conversations! 💖
Are you ready to steal some new jokes from other countries? Or do you want to know which country's culture is the most fascinating?
During the dinner, we will have cultural exchanges and provide delicious meals. Interested students and foreign students are welcome to join us! 

👉Let’s go Chill & Chat!👈

📍Time: March 25 (Tuesday) 12:00-13:30
📍Event location: Jixian Hall 2nd floor, Borderless Student Consumer Cooperative
📍Organizer: National DongHwa University Social Responsibility Center

📍USR email: techusr@gms.ndhu.edu.tw

(This event will focus on international students.)
